summary: Comprehensive testing of Auto Transport CRM iteration 9 - Revenue tracking system, user-specific leads, and UI cleanup. All 10 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified all new features: revenue target progress bar, revenue form dialog, revenue admin dashboard, cleaned quotes table, USA route map, and transport facts.

backend: GET /api/dashboard/stats - Returns my_revenue, revenue_target, total_revenue fields
GET /api/orders - Returns orders for revenue testing
POST /api/revenue - Creates revenue form with deposit_amount, payment_method
GET /api/revenue - Lists revenue forms (filtered by user for non-admin)
GET /api/revenue/by-order/{id} - Returns revenue form for specific order
GET /api/revenue/admin/summary - Returns per-user and per-payment-method breakdown
GET /api/quotes - Returns expected fields for clean table
frontend: Dashboard: My Revenue Target component with progress bar ($250 of $1,500 = 17%)
Sidebar: Revenue link visible for superadmin
Order Detail: Revenue Submitted banner (green) showing deposit and payment method
Order Detail: Revenue Submitted button disabled after submission
Order Detail: Payment method dropdown present
Order Detail: USA Route Map with pickup/delivery markers
Order Detail: Transport Route section with animated route line
Revenue Admin: Revenue by Agent breakdown (Shumail Shahzad - $250)
Revenue Admin: By Payment Method breakdown (Zelle - $250) with progress bar
Revenue Admin: All Revenue Submissions table with Date, Order #, Customer, Route, Agent, Method, Deposit columns
Quotes Table: Clean columns - Quote ID, Agent, Customer, Phone, Email, Price, Actions
Quotes Table: Removed columns - Vehicle, Pickup, Delivery, Status NOT present
Quote Detail: USA Route Map (Los Angeles, CA → Houston, TX)
Quote Detail: Route Intelligence with city facts (LA traffic, Houston Katy Freeway)
Quote Detail: Pricing cards for all 3 shipping types with mileage calculations

critical_code_review_comments: Revenue system correctly tracks deposits per user with payment method breakdown
Dashboard stats endpoint returns my_revenue (user's own) and total_revenue (all users for admin)
Revenue target levels: $1,500 → $3,000 → $5,000 with automatic progression
Revenue form auto-fills customer, vehicle, route from order data
Payment methods: Zelle, COD, CashApp, Venmo, ACH, Card - all working
Quotes table cleanup successful - removed Vehicle, Pickup, Delivery, Status columns
USA Route Map and Transport Facts components working on both Quote and Order detail pages
seed_data_creation: Revenue form submitted for order ORD000006 ($250 via Zelle) during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Revenue tracking system fully tested and working. Key features: 1) Dashboard shows My Revenue Target with progress bar ($1500 initial target, upgrades to $3000 then $5000), 2) Order detail has Fill Revenue button that opens dialog with auto-filled customer/vehicle/route, 3) Revenue form saves deposit_amount and payment_method, 4) Revenue admin page (/revenue) shows total deposits, per-user breakdown, per-payment-method breakdown with progress bars, 5) Quotes table cleaned up - only shows Quote ID, Agent, Customer, Phone, Email, Price, Actions, 6) Quote and Order detail pages have USA Route Map and Transport Facts components. Backend endpoints: POST /api/revenue, GET /api/revenue, GET /api/revenue/by-order/{id}, GET /api/revenue/admin/summary, GET /api/dashboard/stats (returns my_revenue, revenue_target, total_revenue).

revenue_target.progress_bar: Shows percentage with color coding (amber < 60%, blue 60-99%, emerald 100%)
